messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: Error in correctReadDepth
parts:
Hi Dan,

It looks like the number of lines for your gc and map wig files do not match your tumour and normal wig files.  If you do a quick line count on those files, you might see this. 

Based on the difference between lines for your files (3095689 elements in value to replace 3095706 elements), I think it has to do with the presence of chrMT in one file but not the other.  chrMT has exactly 17 lines for 1kb bins.

You can double-check the presence of chrMT by using grep
 
[gavinha@cga03 scripts]$ grep fixed GRCh37-lite.gc.ws_1000.wig

I've started a new analysis using the wig files that are distributed with the TITANRunner source.
